nom: The INKEY List Niacinamide Oil Control Serum

avis.texte: Have used for a few days now, and as someone with super oily skin, this really helps calm down the excess oil. Usually my makeup is half off by the middle of the day, and now my makeup looks decent by the end of the day. Will definitely be repurchasing!
i didn't like it at all. it feels heavy and sticky on the face. i felt like y porse are plugged. not recommended this.

I've repurchased this serum consistently over the last 4 years. Initially it was to control my acne breakouts, which I now rarely get, but when I try to phase this out, always one or a few little pimples will try to pop up. Since then I keep at least two backups!

Have used this for quite awhile but the most recent products I've got of this from the last probably six months the smell is horrendous. I keep thinking it's off. It smells like old plasticine Play-Doh. Should it smell like that? Is it still safe to use? And it's happened on more than one product of this. I thought it must've been a bad one so I ordered another one and it smells the same. It puts me off. I'm using this product.

Great for my sensitive skin- other niacinamide serums I've tried have had added products that irritated my skin, but this was perfect. No weird residue left and is super lightweight and feels great on the skin. Saw results after 2-3 days of use.

Personally I didn't feel that this did anything for me. I tried it to try and tackle excess oil since I was wearing makeup every day to the office. It could just have been the combo of this with the makeup I was wearing or maybe my whole skin routine wasn't blending well together. But I didn't see much of a difference with this one as I do with other products. I personally would not buy again.
This serum is not sticky like all other niacinamide serums I tried. I guess it works well. It¬¥s not though totally matt for use under makeup for oily skin.

I am new to my skincare journey in the last few months, this product works immediately to reduce redness inflammation as well as correcting skin texture and balancing of the skin barrier, I use this product in the morning and at night, I am extremely impressed with the quality and results. Coming from a sensitive skin girly that has tried many products. This is a must!

avis.titre: Love that it comes as a duo
avis.texte: I use this niacinamide every day and love it! I only wish we could buy it in 100 mL like the hyaluronic acid.

To be honest, I'm not really sure what it does for my skin. I occasionally incorporate it into my routine because it's probably doing something? I like that it doesn't give me as many closed comedones like some other ones I've tried.
I used it a few times and it immediately broke me out. Not one star because the break out wasn't severe and my other skincare cleared it up once i stopped using this.

I throughly enjoy this niacinamide serum. It packs a punch. I use this serum everyday after double cleansing and a hydrating serum. Helping to reduce oil and redness, the appearance of pores, and including 1% hydrating hyaluronic acid; this effective and gentle multitasker is not to be overlooked.

I've been using this serum regularly and it truly never disappoints. With consistent use, you can definitely see a difference brighter skin, less visible pores, and a more balanced complexion. It's lightweight, absorbs quickly, and doesn't clash with other products in my routine.

avis.titre: Great product at a great price
avis.texte: Niacinamide is such a great ingredient! And this one is very effective and well absorbed.
I've been using the niacinamide serum for about 5 years now, and it works great for my skin! Helps with oiliness and clearing up the aftermath of breakouts.
I love this serum, it's very silky but absorbs very well onto the skin. I like to use it before the retinol serum at night. But when I use it twice a day I can see the brightening effect. Very gentle

Great product, my skin has been so much better following the use of this product and my skin is looking so much healthier. Was having loads of breakouts prior and now my skin is great since I've been using this product
This is such a nice serum and the skin feels and looks amazing. Been using it twice a day for at least two years now and not planning to change that
I have dry skin but i seem to always be congested around my chin and jawline and this helped control the blackheads without over drying my skin

avis.titre: Niacinamide gave me a glass skin.
avis.texte: The final but also miracle serum that made my skin look like glass.
I really enjoy this serum, feels really nice on my skin. Big fan.

Using this serum has dramatically changed the clarity and tone of my sensitive and reactive skin. Large pores have shrunk, breakouts are far less frequent, redness has lessened and the cluster of whiteheads around my eyes and temples have almost completely cleared. The (badly) bleached photo is a before and the second photo is after four weeks of continuous use morning and evening alongside the hydroectin barrier serum, omega water cream and the ceramide moisturiser in the evening after my prescription retinol.

I generally get this for my daughter and it helps to produce breakouts and keeps pores clear. However, I also heard that it's good for ageing skin so I've started using this myself at 55 and I find it keeps my skin nice and clear as well.
It has been one of the products that I use in my daily routine and it really is helping, my skin is so much better

I've been using INKEY List's Niacinamide for years, and I can definitely see and feel the difference it makes. Over the long term, it's gently helped to remove dead skin and even out my skin tone. In the short term, if I skip a day, my T-zone gets noticeably oilier.

avis.titre: The serum I didn't really know I needed.
avis.texte: Now I know it is an integral part of my skin care routine. It's wonderful on any discolouration on the skin. Plus, it keeps my skin completely normalized. Will keep it in my skin care regimen.
Bought for daughter with 1st time breakouts as she turned 30! Working well to minimise the pigmentation and scarring!

I've used this for years, but recent versions purchased suggest a change in formula - used to be clear and it now has a brown hue. Also feels more tacky and other products feel like they sit less well on top now. They also changed the Oat Cleansing Balm (hard beads in new version). Products have really gone down hill
This product works wonders . I use it everyday in my routine it helps with breakout and keeps the skin clam. It's not sticky on the face.
Been using this for years and it has definitely calmed my redness down. Won't ever be without it.
Great serum for making pores disappear! My only issue is the container. It's difficult to squeeze out a small drop as the serum is runny.
I have started using it for two weeks now and have seen some improvement.
Love the texture of my skin after I used it for a couple of months!

This serum is great to use before retinol. It soothes my skin and it's brightening. It really helps with redness. It seems to go a long way because of the texture, you don't need a lot to cover your face.

This product helped clear my acne and reduce my acne scars. I've been using it for years and when I first started I had pretty bad breakouts. Now I rarely break out, a pimple here or there when I'm on my period or something, and the acne scars have faded.
Really struggle with oil and greasy looking skin, since using this, oil has reduced along with redness. I only apply to my T-Zone as I found it dried the rest of my skin out.
Really helps with avoiding and reducing the rudarion of breakouts
This is a really nice product. It is very lightweight, not sticky, and no scent at all. So far I am pleased with it.
My boyfriend and I love it so much. It will never leave our skincare kit.
Really struggled with oil and greasy looking skin, since using this is so well controlled and reduced, nice consistency, great serum

avis.titre: Helping to control my oily skin, redness & large pores!
avis.texte: I used to use this in the morning and wasn't a fan as it didn't sit well under make up. I now use after cleansing in the evening, before applying the azelaic acid. I suffer with large pores, texture and redness from rosacea and have found that in the last month sticking to a consistent skincare routine and using an LED mask alongside it I've begun noticing an improvement in my rosacea for the first time in years!
This has definitely helped reduce my hormonal breakouts. The picture was taken during a time they'd normally be noticeable, but no, instead I have nice, mostly clear skin.
many have too little or too much percentage. this is a good amount
Has been great for my sink all other products give me chemical burns. I tool the test to see what products beat suit my skin and have been amazed
It's really good at controlling oil, been using it for years now!
It brightens my skin and helps minimize dark spots. Love it! 😇
Helps to reduce oil build up. Bought several times now. Definitely recommend!

avis.titre: This is what keeps bringing me back!
avis.texte: This niacinamide serum is the first product I tried from Inkey List. It does such a great job of calming my breakouts and acne spots! That when I needed more I came back to Inkey List and decided to try new products! It is my OG favourite!
I love this product, my redness is much calmer after a few weeks of using and skin looks plumper

avis.titre: Not my first bottle of this serum
avis.texte: Really like the light texture of this serum, absorbs well, and does not irritate my skin.

avis.titre: Great little item, helps when I need it.
avis.texte: Love this, often get very oily shiny forehead, this always saves the day. I don't use it daily as don't feel the need with the other products I use. Like all inkey products, smells nice, feels nice and or works!!
This product has done me good! Its really gentle on my skin as I have sensitive skin and it is my 3rd purchase.

A lovely serum which really does its job. I have a greasy skin,open pores, uneven skin texture and occasional break outs .I have been using this for a year now and all the mentioned problems are a lot less.
I have been using this serum for around a month now and my skin feels smoother after use. Is a good price point but is just a basic niacinamide serum

I've used similar products in the past and they have helped my skin but I think this has been breaking me out sadly :( Maybe because it's a strong formula. Will keep trying with it because it's a great texture and super light and absorbent.
Bought for my 13 year old son as part of his skincare routine as he suffers from acne, especially on his forehead. He uses it morning and night and helps brighten and fade acne scars.

Thick consistency, feels a bit too tacky and I'm unsure if the the product is helping just on its own. However this along with the vitamin c have definitely improved my skin concerns: dark spots, dullness!

I have been using this product for some time now and found it helped with my combination skin. I ordered 2 bottles of Niacinamide Serum, expecting to receive the usual product, but the colour was a brownish colour, where it was normally white/clear and the smell from both bottles was like old paint. I complained about this and eventually received replacements which turned out to be exactly the same. Not impressed!
Love this product, I tried this product vs the glow recipe and it honestly had the same affect love both anyways, this one is just cheaper
I've tried several niacinimide serums and this is definitely one of the best! With faster results at a much better price!

I really wanted to like this cream. I'm not very into skin care routine and try it for the first time. Ordered the hyaluronic acid serum , niacinamide serum, omega water cream and hyaluronic acid cleanser. My skin is getting dryer and dryer progressively. Every morning I wake up with white skins everywhere, mostly under the mouth. I even started 2 days ago adding 1 or 2 drops of jojoba oil but for now no changes... I'm very disappointed in general... My skin hasn't improved at all after 1 month of using the products every single day, in fact, it got worse with new pimples every day.
This is easy to use, a small bit goes a long way and it's really helped my pores

I have an oily, acne prone skin, so niacinamide serum is always part of my everyday skincare routine. I am satisfied inkey list niacinamide serum and use it for 2 years. My skin absorbs it fully and doesn't rub.
You can not go wrong with this serum! helped alot of my oiliness!!

Seems fine but just doesn't agree with my skin. Initially I used it daily and it caused a red area of sensitivity and irritation over my whole face. I've used it sparingly since on my chin and not had the same reaction as long as I don't use it on consecutive days but it can't be effective with such sporadic usage. Just not for me.
I use this as part of my daily routine for better looking skin.
This rapidly reduces the redness around blemishes, making them feel much better and makes them much less visible.
I am on 3rd bottle, and I can say that there is no redness on my face now.
I'm on my third bottle of this and I will not stop using it. My only problem is that it's TOO SMAL. WE NEED A SUPER SIZE NIACINAMIDE SERUM INKEY!!
Make my skin look great and reduce my oil production in 3 months only. My sebaceous filament are gone.
helped a lot with oiliness on my face especially in my t zone but do try to use consistently to see results, and it helped with redness from acne and works great paired with 15% vitamin c
It has definetly improved the texture of my skin! Just wish the bottle was larger!!!
i have normal skin type and only occasionally break out. i use this to try to keep my breakouts to a minimum.
This is a lightweight product that is simple to apply. It does not leave any residue on my skin and absorbs quickly.

I really like this serum, it's simple but effective and a much nicer formula than other 1 ingredient serums. It's had a brilliant impact on my skin. I'm on my 5th or 6th bottle! I just wish there was a bigger size available!

I use this product to tackle the redness from acne and it works perfectly, I use it twice a day and the redness decreases within 5 minutes. It is also good for reducing the appearance of acne and kind to your skin.

avis.titre: So lightweight and gentle on the skin
avis.texte: I love the feel of this on my skin, it feels hydrating and does its job

avis.titre: Effective and pleasant to use serum
avis.texte: Fast absorption, it helps me minimize skin imperfections and makes a smooth, uniform, complexion, good price too.

I dont recommend this product. I was very excited to use the serum but I broke out quite dramatically after using. Once I stopped using the breakouts cleared and haven't returned. I did some research and it turns out this is a fairly common reaction, possibly due to the high concentration of niacinamide. I recommend using a different product if you have sensitive skin

This product saves my skin ... due to my career /work m, since pandemic my skin suffered so much .. im allergic to mask .. after a year i have a lot of redness , blackheads, so much stress related prob thus my confidence has been compromised... i tried a lot but this standout .. now Niacimide one is one of my go to Products ... and i cant live without it...thanks inkey...
I really don't notice much of a difference after using this product

avis.titre: The best mixture of my skin care!
avis.texte: I used it daily with my Hyaluronic Acid Serum and Retinol Serum. After a week I do feel my skin becomes become more moisturized and more stable!
